what_changed_from_v3: A negative vocabulary: a surface whose own words name an excluded or non-transforming operation is refused BY NAME with a reason, instead of being read as its nearest neighbour.
A searched witness replaces every declared table: witness_for_parameter searches 2,800 inputs over 9 parameter pairs; all 9 are witnessed in under 0.01 s each.
shapes_separate() and REFUSED__A_WITNESS_EXISTS_BUT_NO_SHAPE_IS_ONE: a witness the design space cannot express is a refusal, not a certificate.
Two new shapes (lines_leading_blank, lines_control_byte) came FROM found witnesses, taking the space to 20 shapes and 96 behaviours.
Two over-pruning bugs removed from optimal_move; a truncation flag added to smallest_certificate_tree so a capped search cannot report its fallback as exact.
refusals_by_name: fold -s: no key reproduces it, removed
sort -c: a checker, not a transform
sort -f: not a key function, removed

honest_limits: Every number here comes from running the mechanism in this session; none is recalled from prose.

The node-capped tree search reports an UPPER BOUND of 7 because it exhausts 50,000 nodes. The root optimum is 6, proved by an uncapped brute force that took 1,629 seconds and by the pruned search that now runs in ~1.7 s. The two searches agree; the truncation is recorded in the result.
sort -b and sort -i are NOT invisible. V3 said they were; that was a failed search reported as a property of the program. Both are certified in 4 witnesses and survive held-out.

sort -b/sort -i are exact on the claimed alphabet (abcXYZ019 ._-[]()\t\x01\x7f), 0/2000 each. They are NOT exact when a line holds a control byte other than \x01 or \x7f (10-22 of 400-800). That is in the docstrings and it bounds the certificate.

Four shapes are refused because the witness exists but no shape in the design space is such an input (REFUSED__A_WITNESS_EXISTS_BUT_NO_SHAPE_IS_ONE, with the witness attached). That is a different failure from 'no witness exists' and the two are never merged.
uniq -c certifies on count_runs, which its declaration never names ('count' does not select it). The record reports named_in_class=[] rather than pretending the declaration pointed here.

17 certified is not 17 known programs solved. Each is one flag of one program, against 20 shapes and 26 primitives. 47 surfaces refuse, 4 are equivalent on the declared space, and the algebra still cannot express version sort, case-folding sort, or fold -s at all.
